text:
Ava: Hey team — Altura Therapeutics renewal review on Mon. They asked for a concise SLA/SLO packet (uptime %, latency targets, and credit calc). Can we get a single report I can share with execs?

Ravi: I can draft the customer-facing slide, but I need verified uptime and p50/p95 latency for the last 90 days. Also need the exact credit formula we should communicate.

Elena: I can export the latency histograms and the dashboard links. Which time window do you want? 30/90/365? Altura cares about both monthly and rolling-90.

Ava: Rolling-90 preferred for health conversations, but they want monthly breakdowns for billing. So include both.

Noah: For uptime, we compute SLA as uptime = 1 - (total_downtime_seconds / total_window_seconds). We record incidents in the incident-log; need to confirm which incidents we include (partial region degradation vs total service down).

Ravi: Good point. The contract says "service unavailability affecting all API endpoints in the customer's region". So we should exclude partial degradations unless they meet the contract threshold. I'll attach the clause in the doc.

Elena: I ran a quick query to pull availability from the metrics store. Example query I used:
```
-- uptime over window
SELECT 1 - SUM(case when status='down' then duration_seconds else 0 end)::float / SUM(duration_seconds) as uptime
FROM service_availability
WHERE customer_id = 'altura' AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days';
```
This aligns with how reporting-bot calculates it but with customer scoping.

reporting-bot: Generated draft availability snapshot for altura: 99.972% (rolling-90). See /dashboards/altura/availability.

Ava: Nice — can you also get latency p50/p95 across the same window and split by production region? The customer raised concerns about EU region spikes.

Noah: Will do. Quick heads-up: quantizing p95 across bursts can be noisy; recommend using 5-min aggregated percentiles to smooth. I'll attach the aggregation method.

Elena: Attaching CSV at /files/altura_latency_90d.csv (p50,p75,p95,p99 by day & region). Preview: p50 global=38ms, p95 global=240ms, EU p95=310ms (spikes correlate with a small batch job we throttled earlier).

Ravi: For credit calc — per contract: credits = max(0, floor((SLA_target - observed_uptime) / SLA_target * monthly_fee)). Example: SLA target 99.9%, observed 99.7% gives credits = floor((0.999 - 0.997)/0.999 * monthly_fee). Should we show a worked example?

Ava: Yes, include one worked example using their current monthly commitment. Also add language that credits are the exclusive remedy per contract. Keep it simple for execs.

Noah: I'll validate incident inclusion. Also propose we offer an operational note: for EU latency spikes we recommend enabling regional routing to avoid cross-region fallback until we patch the batch job.

Elena: I'll add the dashboard links + screenshots (latency heatmap + uptime timeline) and annotate the days with incidents.

Ava: Great. Action items: (1) Ravi — draft slide text and worked credit example (due EOD Fri). (2) Elena — export CSVs + screenshots + link (due EOD Thu). (3) Noah — confirm incident exclusions and validation (due EOD Thu). (4) I'll assemble slides and sync with legal on phrasing.

Ravi: Ack. I'll start draft and ping legal for the credit paragraph.

reporting-bot: Noted action items and created ticket CS-4827 assigned to Ava. :white_check_mark:

Ava: Thanks everyone — want to do a quick 15-min prep on Mon at 9am before the renewal call. :thumbsup:
